opening.argument: The speaker presents a Polkadot chart analysis, not a promise of returns. That bounce may be a wave-two recovery or part of a continuing third wave down; a more bullish reading depends on price reaching upper resistance without rejection. These are conditional market scenarios, not assured outcomes.
